name: Board
author: PyCmd
description: A board for plans and notes: drop notes, headings, to-do lists, images and links anywhere, drag them around, colour them and connect them with arrows. Pan and zoom, several boards, saves itself. `note <text>` in the console drops a note on your board.

tab.description: Notes, images and to-dos you can arrange and connect
